spans.s: Most abundant, very great, excessive; (superl. of बहुल q. v.).
More numerous or abundant, much more, exceeding; (compar. of बहुल q. v.).
बंह् [baṃh], 1 Ā. (बंहते, बंहित) To increase, grow. -Caus.
A prisoner, captive; मोक्ष्यते सुरबन्दीनां वेणीर्वीर्यविभूतिभिः
.-Comp. -ग्रहः taking prisoner, capture. -ग्राहः a house breaker, robber. -पालः a jailor. -शूला a harlot, prostitute. -स्थित a. imprisoned.
बन्दिन् [bandin], See बन्धिन्. A bard, herald; धर्मच्छेदात् पटुतरगिरो बन्दिनो नीलकण्ठाः
बन्द् [band], 1 P. To divide; L. D. B.
A hair-band, fillet; रतिविगलितबन्धे केशहस्ते सुकेश्याः (सति)
Fettering, confining, imprisoning, confinement, imprisonment; बन्धं चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभ
; अधार्मिकं त्रिभिर्न्यायैर्निगृह्णीयात् प्रयत्नतः । निरोधनेन बन्धेन विविधेन वधेन च ॥
Catching, capturing, catching hold of; गजबन्ध
(a) Forming, constructing, arranging; सर्गबन्धो महाकाव्यम् S.
Feeling, conceiving, cherishing; हे राजानस्त्यजत सुकविप्रेमबन्धे विरोधम्
Joining or folding together, combining; प्रासादवातायनदृश्यबन्धैः साकेतनार्यो$- ञ्जलिभिः प्रणेमुः
Bondage, confinement to this world (opp. मुक्ति which is 'complete emancipation from the trammels of the world'); बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
A position, posture in general; आसनबन्धधीरः
A particular position in sexual intercourse, or a particular mode of sexual enjoyment (these are said in Ratimañjarī to be 16, but other writers increase the number to 84).
Arrangement of a stanza in a particular shape; e. g. खड्गबन्ध, पद्मबन्ध, मुरजबन्ध (vide K.
An embankment, throwing a bridge across (a river).

A disease in which the eyelids cannot be wholly closed. -Comp. -करणम् fettering, imprisoning. -कर्तृ m. a binder, fetterer. -तन्त्रम् a complete army containing the four necessary elements, i. e. elephants, horses, chariots and footmen. -नृत्यम् a kind of dance-पारुष्यम् forced or unnatural construction of words.-मुद्रा impression or mark of fetters. -स्तम्भः a post to which an animal (e. g. an elephat) is tied.
बन्धकः [bandhakḥ], 1 One who binds or catches, a binder.
A part or portion (at the end of num. compounds); ऋणं सदश- बन्धकम्
की An unchaste woman; न मे त्वया कौमारबन्धक्या प्रयोजनम्
A harlot, courtezan; अतः परं स्वैरिणी स्याद्बन्धकी पञ्चमे भवेत्
(At the end of comp.) Dependent upon; cf. निबन्धन. -नम् [बन्ध्-भावे-ल्युट्]
The act of binding, fastening; tying; स्मरसि स्मर मेखलागुणैरुत गोत्रस्खलितेषु बन्धनम्
Binding on or round, throwing round, clasping; विनम्रशाखाभुजबन्धनानि
Bondage confinement, imprisonment, captivity; as in बन्धनागार.
A place of confinement, prison, jail; वसुदेवस्य देवक्यां जातो भोजेन्द्रबन्धने
; त्वां कारयामि कमलोदरबन्धनस्थम् Ś.6.2; द्विगुणं त्रिगुणं पश्चाद्यावज्जीवं तु बन्धनम् Śukra.4.8;
A stalk, stem, peduncle (of a flower); कृतं न कर्णार्पितबन्धनं सखे Ś.6.18.;
A sinew, muscle; संधिन्नसंधिः प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः
ग्रन्थिः the knot of a bandage.

a rope for tying cattle. -पालकः, -रक्षिन् m. a jailor. -वेश्मन् n. a prison. -स्थः a captive, prisoner. -स्तम्भः a tying-post, a post to which an animal (e. g. an elephant) is tied. -स्थानम् a stable, stall (for horses &c.).
बन्धयितृ [bandhayitṛ], A binder; cf. Kull. on
A relation, kinsman, relative in general; यत्र द्रुमा अपि मृगा अपि बन्धवो मे
Any one connected or associated with another, a brother; प्रवासबन्धुः a brothertraveller; धर्मबन्धुः a spiritual brother; अनुमतगमना शकुन्तला तरुभिरियं वनवासबन्धुभिः Ś.4.1.
(In law) A cognate kinsman, one's own kindred or kinsmen generally; (three kinds are enumerated: आत्म˚ personal, पितृ˚ paternal, and मातृ˚ maternal; see these three words).
A friend (in general); as in बन्धुकृत्य below; oft. at the end of comp.; मकरन्दगन्धबन्धो
'a friend of, (i. e.) charged with fragrance'; &c.; 9.13.
The tree called बन्धुजीव q. v.

One who belongs to or is connected with any tribe or profession only nominally;i. e. one who belongs to it, but does not do the duties pertaining thereto (often used by way of contempt); स्वयमेव ब्रह्मबन्धुनोद्भिन्नो दुर्गप्रयोगः
Connection, relationship, association in general; समुद्र एवास्य बन्धुः Bṛi.
(In astrol.) N. of the 3rd mansion. -Comp. -काम a. affectionate towards kinsmen.
कृत्यम् the duty of a kinsman; त्वयि तु परिसमाप्तं बन्धुकृत्यं प्रजानाम् Ś.5.8.
the business of a friend, a friendly or kind act or service; कच्चित् सौम्य व्यवसितमिदं बन्धुकृत्यं त्वया मे
kindred, kinsmen taken collectively. -जीवः, -जीवकः N. of a tree; दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाश्च श्यामाश्च गिरिसानुषु
. -दग्धः an abandoned wretch (हतक). -दत्तम् a kind of Strīdhana or woman's property, the property given to a girl by her relatives at the time of marriage; बन्धुदत्तं तथा शुल्कमन्वा- धेयकमेव च
; बान्धवा भ्रातरो बन्धुदत्तप्रदेन कन्यादशायां यत् पितृभ्यां दत्तं तदुच्यते Dāy. B. -दायादः kinsman and heir;
. -a. entitled to inheritance by relationship. -प्रिय a. dear to friends or relations.-प्रीतिः f.
relationship. -वर्गः kinsmen, kindred. -हीन a. destitute of relatives or friends.
A bastard. -का, -की An unchaste woman (see बन्धकी).
बन्धूकः [bandhūkḥ], [बन्ध्-ऊक] N. of a tree; तवकरनिकरेण स्पष्ट- बन्धूकसूनस्तबकरचितमेते शेखरं बिभ्रतीव Śi.11.46; Ṛs.3.5. -कम् A flower of this tree; बन्धूकद्युतिबान्धवो$यमधरः
बन्धुता [bandhutā], 1 Relatives, kinsmen, kindred (taken collectively); प्रेयो मित्रं बन्धुता वा समग्रा
बन्धुमत् [bandhumat], a. Having relations or kinsmen.
Pleasing, handsome, beautiful, lovely; कथं नु तं बन्धुरकोमलाङ्गुलिम् Ś.6.12 (where it may mean 'undulating' also); समस्तशास्त्रस्मृतिबन्धुरे मुखे
The बन्धुजीव tree.-राः m. (pl.) Parched corn or meal thereof. -रा An unchaste woman.
Pleasing, delightful, lovely; cf. बन्धुर. -रम् A hole, chasm.
लः A bastard; परगृहललिताः परान्नपुष्टाः परपुरुषैर्जनिताः पराङ्गनासु । परधननिरता गुणेष्ववाच्या गजकलभा इव बन्धुला ललामः
(which is an answer given by the bandhulas themselves to the Vidūṣaka's question भोः के यूयं बन्धुला नाम).
An attendant in a harlot's chamber.
The tree called बन्धूक q. v.
बन्धूकृ [bandhūkṛ], 1 To make a friend of.
बन्ध् [bandh], 9 P. (बध्नाति, बबन्ध, अभांत्सीत्, भंत्स्यति, बन्द्धुम्, बद्धः; pass. बध्यते)
To bind, tie, fasten; बन्द्धुं न संभावित एव तावत् करेण रुद्धो$पि च केशपाशः
To catch, capture, imprison, ensnare, make captive; कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते Bg 4.14; बलिर्बबन्धे
To check, stop, suppress; as in बद्धकोप, बद्धकोष्ठ &c.
To put on, wear; न हि चूडामणिः पादे प्रभवामीति बध्यते
To attract, arrest (as eyes &c.); बबन्ध चक्षूंषि यवप्ररोहः
To fix or set upon, direct towards (as the eyes or mind), cast upon (with loc.); दृष्टिं लक्ष्येषु बध्नन्
To bind or fasten together (as hair); पूर्णप्रतिज्ञेन मया केवल बध्यते शिखा
To build, construct, form, arrange; बद्धोर्मिनाकवनितापरिभुक्तमुक्तम्
; छायाबद्धकदम्बकं मृगकुलम् Ś.2.6; तस्याञ्जलिं बन्धुमतो बबन्ध
To put together, compose, construct (a poem, verse &c.); तुष्टैर्बद्धं तदलघु रघुस्वामिनः सच्चरित्रम्
To form, produce, bear (as fruit &c.); काले खलु समारब्धाः फलं बध्नन्ति नीतयः
To have, possess, entertain, cherish, feel.

To display, exhibit, show. (The senses of बन्ध् are variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; e. g. भ्रुकुटिं बन्ध् to knit or bend the eyebrows, to frown; मुष्टिं बन्ध् to clench the fist; अञ्जलिं बन्ध् to fold the hands together in supplication; चित्तं, धियं, मनः, हृदयं बन्ध् to set the heart on; प्रीतिं, भावं, रागं बन्ध् to fall in love with, be enamoured of; सेतुं बन्ध् to construct or build a bridge; वैरं बन्ध् to conceive hatred, contract enmity; सख्यं, सौहृदं बन्ध् to form friendship; गोलं बन्ध् to form a globe; मण्डलं बन्ध् to form a circle, sit or stand in a circle; मौनं बन्ध् to maintain silence; परिकरं, कक्षां बन्ध् to gird up one's loins, prepare oneself for any thing; see the compounds under बद्ध also). -Caus. To cause to bind, form, construct, build &c.; स सेतुं बन्धयामास प्लवगैर्लवणाम्भसि
To be bound or fettered, to be confined or imprisoned; अबन्ध्यं यश्च बध्नाति बद्धं यश्च प्रमुञ्चति
To be joined or bound together.
To be formed, built or constructed.
(= वन्ध्य) Barren, unproductive, fruitless; useless (said of persons or things); बन्ध्यश्रमास्ते
Not having the menses or menstrual discharge.
(At the end of comp.) Deprived or destitute of. -Comp. -फल a. useless, vain, idle.
A barren woman; न हि बन्ध्या विजानाति गुर्वी प्रसववेदनाम् Subhāṣ.

A kind or perfume (बाल). -Comp. -तनयः, -पुत्रः, -सुतः, or दुहिता, -सुता &c. the son or daughter of a barren woman; i. e. a wild impossibility, anything that does not and cannot exist; एष बन्ध्यासुतो याति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः; see खपुष्प.
A relation, kinsman (in general); बान्धवाः कुलमिच्छन्ति Subhāṣ; यस्यार्थास्तस्य बान्धवाः
A friend; धनेभ्यः परो बान्धवो नास्ति लोके Subhāṣ.
.-Comp. -जनः relatives, kinsmen (taken collectively); दारिद्र्यात् पुरुषस्य बान्धवजनो वाक्ये न संतिष्ठते
